issue.body:
### Issue URL (Incorrect Blocking)
[https://pal.bio/](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fpal.bio%2F)

### Comment
> **pal.bio is incorrectly blocked by AdGuard DNS (Default server).**
> 
> pal.bio is the link-in-bio service operated by Pallyy (https://pallyy.com), a social media management platform. Each user gets a profile page at `pal.bio/<username>` with their social links.
> 
> **Evidence of the block (DNS sinkhole):**
> 
> $ dig +short `@94.140.14.14` pal.bio    # Default filtering server
> 94.140.14.33
> 
> $ dig +short `@94.140.14.140` pal.bio   # Non-filtering server
> 216.24.57.1
> 
> 
> 
> **Background:** the listing appears to stem from phishing pages created by a small number of abusive user accounts — a common abuse pattern for link-in-bio services. As the domain owner we have removed all offending pages (they now return HTTP 404), terminated the accounts, and added screening of user-submitted URLs to prevent recurrence. The domain serves only our application code, is not listed in PhishTank, and Google Safe Browsing reports no unsafe content. Delisting requests are in progress with other vendors for the same stale listing.
> 
> Please remove `pal.bio` from the DNS filter. Contact: `hey@pallyy.com` (domain owner).



### Screenshots

  <summary>Screenshot 1</summary>

  ![Screenshot 1](https://cdn.adguardcdn.com/sitereports/pncz617lr9cwkgso0oksggoskc44sokto2ctcj19mo.png?nc=1)

Unfortunately, our resources are limited and we can not always take the time to respond to requests about websites that are not popular enough. The issue will be closed if no further activity occurs.
Please note, that AdGuard Filters is an open-source project that is used by different content blockers and we welcome contributions. If you have some technical knowledge about how websites work, you are welcome to create a pull request following [these instructions](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md).

issue.body:
### Issue URL (Incorrect Blocking)
[https://pal.bio/](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fpal.bio%2F)

### Comment
> **pal.bio is incorrectly blocked by AdGuard DNS (Default server).**
> 
> pal.bio is the link-in-bio service operated by Pallyy (https://pallyy.com), a social media management platform. Each user gets a profile page at `pal.bio/<username>` with their social links.
> 
> **Evidence of the block (DNS sinkhole):**
> 
> $ dig +short `@94.140.14.14` pal.bio    # Default filtering server
> 94.140.14.33
> 
> $ dig +short `@94.140.14.140` pal.bio   # Non-filtering server
> 216.24.57.1
> 
> 
> 
> **Background:** the listing appears to stem from phishing pages created by a small number of abusive user accounts — a common abuse pattern for link-in-bio services. As the domain owner we have removed all offending pages (they now return HTTP 404), terminated the accounts, and added screening of user-submitted URLs to prevent recurrence. The domain serves only our application code, is not listed in PhishTank, and Google Safe Browsing reports no unsafe content. Delisting requests are in progress with other vendors for the same stale listing.
> 
> Please remove `pal.bio` from the DNS filter. Contact: `hey@pallyy.com` (domain owner).



### Screenshots

  <summary>Screenshot 1</summary>

  ![Screenshot 1](https://cdn.adguardcdn.com/sitereports/pncz617lr9cwkgso0oksggoskc44sokto2ctcj19mo.png?nc=1)

> # Summary:

> - Configure Adgaurd DNS on the router or PC from which the site is accessed.

> - Configure a different DNS server on the router or PC from which the site is accessed.

issue.body:
### Issue URL (Incorrect Blocking)
[https://pal.bio/](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fpal.bio%2F)

### Comment
> **pal.bio is incorrectly blocked by AdGuard DNS (Default server).**
> 
> pal.bio is the link-in-bio service operated by Pallyy (https://pallyy.com), a social media management platform. Each user gets a profile page at `pal.bio/<username>` with their social links.
> 
> **Evidence of the block (DNS sinkhole):**
> 
> $ dig +short `@94.140.14.14` pal.bio    # Default filtering server
> 94.140.14.33
> 
> $ dig +short `@94.140.14.140` pal.bio   # Non-filtering server
> 216.24.57.1
> 
> 
> 
> **Background:** the listing appears to stem from phishing pages created by a small number of abusive user accounts — a common abuse pattern for link-in-bio services. As the domain owner we have removed all offending pages (they now return HTTP 404), terminated the accounts, and added screening of user-submitted URLs to prevent recurrence. The domain serves only our application code, is not listed in PhishTank, and Google Safe Browsing reports no unsafe content. Delisting requests are in progress with other vendors for the same stale listing.
> 
> Please remove `pal.bio` from the DNS filter. Contact: `hey@pallyy.com` (domain owner).



### Screenshots

  ![Screenshot 1](https://cdn.adguardcdn.com/sitereports/pncz617lr9cwkgso0oksggoskc44sokto2ctcj19mo.png?nc=1)

Please block Ad-Shield advertisement by installing [tinyShield userscript](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield).
Please check its installation guideline written in English by visiting [this URL](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.md).

If you can understand Korean language, please refer https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.ko.md.

New change of tinyShield's build script for Apple Safari Extension user (made at 2026 Apr 21) is available.

## Still Have a Problem?
An issue is occurred when the userscript is applied, please report to [this issue tracker](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/issues).

### Comment
> Muscle & Motion app is not working correctly with AdGuard DNS
> I am a Muscle & Motion user and I am experiencing a login problem in the Android app when AdGuard DNS is enabled.
> The app is unable to complete the login. I enter my correct email address and password and tap Log In, but nothing happens and the app remains on the login screen.
> The same account and password work correctly on my computer.
> Muscle & Motion support investigated the issue and reported it to AdGuard as a false positive. They provided me with the following information:
> Blocked domain: app.muscleandmotion.com
> CNAME: production-alb-2133557625.us-east-1.elb.amazonaws.com
> Blocked response: 94.140.14.33
> Correct response: 100.51.209.101, 44.198.222.187
> AdGuard resolver: dns.adguard.com
> Muscle & Motion support asked me to report this directly to AdGuard and provided these details for investigation.
> Please investigate why AdGuard DNS is returning the blocked response instead of the correct IP addresses and is preventing the Muscle & Motion app from completing the login.

### Issue URL (Incorrect Blocking)
[https://www.gst.gov.in/](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.gst.gov.in%2F)

### Comment
> # Summary:
> With Adgaurd default DNS enabled on the router, the url https://gst.gov.in does not load properly. However, on the adapter settings for Wifi locally on the Windows 11 PC to point to a different DNS, such as 8.8.8.8, the page loads as expected.
> 
> ## Steps to produce the issue:
> - Configure Adgaurd DNS on the router or PC from which the site is accessed.
> - Access the url https://gst.gov.in and the page does not load.
> - Configure a different DNS server on the router or PC from which the site is accessed.
> - Access the url and the page will load correctly.
>

issue.body:
# Sorry. The website is infected by AdShield, Inc.

Unfortunately, It is complicated to resolve with a regular adblock rule because the website is being protected by service of Ad-Shield that is an anti-adblock company.

## Userscript Installation
Please block Ad-Shield advertisement by installing [tinyShield userscript](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield).
Please check its installation guideline written in English by visiting [this URL](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.md).

If you can understand Korean language, please refer https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.ko.md.

New change of tinyShield's build script for Apple Safari Extension user (made at 2026 Apr 21) is available.

## Still Have a Problem?
An issue is occurred when the userscript is applied, please report to [this issue tracker](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/issues).

issue.body:
### Issue URL (Incorrect Blocking)
[https://www.gst.gov.in/](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.gst.gov.in%2F)

### Comment
> # Summary:
> With Adgaurd default DNS enabled on the router, the url https://gst.gov.in does not load properly. However, on the adapter settings for Wifi locally on the Windows 11 PC to point to a different DNS, such as 8.8.8.8, the page loads as expected.
> 
> ## Steps to produce the issue:
> - Configure Adgaurd DNS on the router or PC from which the site is accessed.
> - Access the url https://gst.gov.in and the page does not load.
> - Configure a different DNS server on the router or PC from which the site is accessed.
> - Access the url and the page will load correctly.
>

issue.body:
### Issue URL (Social Widget) [https://friday.kodansha.co.jp/article/475315?page=1](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Ffriday.kodansha.co.jp%2Farticle%2F475315%3Fpage%3D1) ### Comment > Bug report: Social share buttons are no longer hidden > > # Summary > > On this website (the site referenced in this issue), the social media share buttons stop being blocked and remain visible. > > ## Conditions for reproduction > > The issue occurs only when both of the following filters are added as custom filters (i.e. not enabled from the built-in filter sections of the app) and turned on: > > • Japanese filter (full, non-optimized): https://filters.adtidy.org/ios/filters/7.txt > • Social filter (full, non-optimized): https://filters.adtidy.org/ios/filters/4.txt > > Notes on what does not trigger the issue: > > • Adding other filters as custom filters does not cause the problem. > • The built-in Social filter + custom Japanese filter → no issue. > • Custom Social filter + built-in Japanese filter → no issue. > • The problem appears only when both filters are subscribed as custom filters. > > # Workaround > > Adding a user rule that hides the affected element resolves the problem temporarily. > Notably, re-adding a rule that should already be included in the Social media filter as a user rule also fixes it. In other words, the rule itself works fine — it is being neutralized by something in the filter setup. > > # My hypothesis > > Some rule that exists in the diff between the optimized version (bundled in the app) and the full, non-optimized version of the filters appears to interfere with the removal of the share buttons. > > I don’t believe this is caused by hitting the iOS content blocker rule limit, because adding filters with a larger rule count than the Japanese filter (e.g. the Cookie notices filter) did not reproduce the problem. > > Why “just use the optimized filters” is not a solution for me > > I visit a very large number of websites for both work and personal use. If I had to report every rule that was stripped out by optimization each time something breaks, the optimized filters would defeat their own purpose. As long as the iOS rule limit is not exceeded, I see no fundamental problem with subscribing to the full versions via custom filters. > > # Request > > I would appreciate an investigation and a fix (or an explanation of the underlying conflict). > I’m happy to provide any additional information you need — logs, screenshots, exported settings, the exact rules involved, etc. Please let me know what would help. > I’d kindly ask that this not be closed simply as “cannot reproduce” — I’m glad to work through the reproduction steps together. > > Thank you. ### Screenshots

issue.body:
### ATTENTION

This issue is known to be solved with [AdGuard Extra](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdGuardExtra) userscript.

If you're using AdGuard for Windows, Mac or Android, please make sure that AdGuard Extra is enabled in the application settings.

If you're using AdGuard Browser Extension, we suggest installing AdGuard Extra in addition to it.

* [Install for Chrome, Edge or other Chromium-based browsers](https://agrd.io/adguard_extra_chrome_release)
* [Install for Firefox](https://agrd.io/adguard_extra_firefox_release)
